arguments.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='docs/threads.md'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('(default empty). A glob without `/` matches the file name (`.env*` matches `config/.env.local`). A glob with `/` matches the full path. `**` matches across directories.','(default empty). The globs work as in `.gitignore`: `.env*` matches `config/.env.local`, and `docs/**/a.txt` matches `docs/secrets/a.txt`.')
s=s.replace('When pi-action does not save a file, the message to pi in the next run lists the file and the reason.','When pi-action does not save a file because of its size, the message to pi in the next run lists the file and the reason.')
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='README.md'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('Globs of untracked files never to save in a snapshot, one per line or comma-separated, for example','Globs (as in `.gitignore`) of untracked files never to save in a snapshot, one per line or comma-separated, for example')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
npm run check >/tmp/c.log 2>&1; echo $?; grep -E "error|×|FAIL" /tmp/c.log | head; git diff --shortstat
